Shift Vertex IDs Down Past Deleted IDs

Source: R/update.R
shiftVec.Rd

Subtracts from each vertex ID in orig the number of deleted IDs in del that are less than or equal to it, so that the IDs left after a deletion are consecutive again. Both vectors must be sorted in increasing order.

Usage

shiftVec(orig, del)

Arguments

orig

Sorted vector of vertex IDs.

del

Sorted vector of deleted vertex IDs.

Value

An integer vector the length of orig.

Details

For example, orig = 1:10 and del = c(4, 6, 8, 9) return c(1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 5, 6), so the IDs kept (1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10) become 1 to 6.
